page.title: Admin
page.subtitle: Manage games, sync card data, and the card image vector database

board.heading: Board
board.description: Connect a kit board, flash firmware if it's new, and run the self-test. Connecting here skips the automatic self-test, so a bare board with nothing plugged in still works.

servos.heading: Servo bench
servos.description: Plug a servo into a channel, run it through its range, then mark it as passed or failed. Center puts it in the middle of its range, ready for fitting the horn.
servos.centerHint: Center is pulse {{pulse}}. Release cuts power so the servo can be turned by hand.

continuous.heading: Continuous servo
continuous.description: Spin a continuous-rotation servo, like the feeder motor, in either direction. It keeps spinning until you stop it.

sensors.heading: Sensors
sensors.description: Reads the IR sensors continuously. Pass a card in front of each one: a sensor is verified once it has seen both a card and no card.
sensors.empty: Start reading to see the sensors.

report.heading: Kit report
report.description: A summary of this session to keep with the kit.
report.title: Kit test report

status.busy: The board is busy with another command.

toasts.commandFailed: The board didn't accept the command

cardImageVectors.heading: Card Image Vectors
cardImageVectors.concurrencyDescription: Vectorizes this many card images at once. Downloads still start a short time apart.
cardImageVectors.browserWorking: This computer is vectorizing {{count}} cards at a time. Keep this page open.

syncCardById.heading: Sync Card by ID
syncCardById.description: Fetch and vectorize a single card, adding it if it isn't in the database yet

dumpDatabase.heading: Dump Card Database
dumpDatabase.description: Permanently delete card image vectors, for one game or all of them
dumpDatabase.confirmAll: This will permanently delete all card image vectors and cannot be undone. Are you sure?
dumpDatabase.confirmScoped: This will permanently delete all "{{scope}}" card image vectors and cannot be undone. Are you sure?

impersonationUsersManager.heading: Impersonate User
impersonationUsersManager.description: Search for a user to view the app as them, for support/debugging
impersonationUsersManager.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, email or organization...
impersonationUsersManager.startTyping: Start typing a name, email or organization to search

confirmDialog.title: Impersonate this user?
confirmDialog.description: You'll see the app exactly as {{email}} does, including their organizations and data. This is logged. You can exit impersonation at any time from the banner at the top of the screen.

metricsStats.heading: Scan stats
metricsStats.description: App-wide scan activity across every organization, and whether each scan was vectorized on the server or in the browser. Someone counts as actively scanning while they've saved a scan in the last {{minutes}} minutes.

rollbarTest.heading: Test Rollbar
rollbarTest.description: Send a test error to Rollbar from the client and/or the server to confirm error reporting is wired up

toasts.serverError: Failed to send test error to Rollbar (server)

devicePlayground.heading: Device playground
devicePlayground.description: Send any firmware command to the connected sorter and see its raw response. Developer tool, see firmware/PROTOCOL.md for the full protocol.
devicePlayground.warning: Commands go straight to the sorter and skip the usual self-test gate. Calibration sent from here isn't saved; reconnect to restore the saved calibration.

outcome.busy: The sorter is busy with another command. Try again when it's done.

commands.getStatus: Reports firmware version, board, hardware id and BLE state.
commands.readIR: Reads every module's IR sensor and the hopper sensor.
commands.setChannelOffset: Sets the channel layout (0 standard, 4 legacy) and resets every servo to neutral.
commands.test: Runs the full self-test. Refuses if a module sensor reads a card.
commands.neutral: Moves every servo to its closed or neutral position and stops the feeder.
commands.clearDevice: Opens every trapdoor at once to flush stuck cards, then returns to neutral.
commands.servoPosition: Moves one servo to a calibrated position. Trapdoor and paddle take open/closed, the pusher takes left/neutral/right.
commands.servoValue: Drives one servo at a raw pulse, ignoring calibration.
commands.channel: Drives a raw PCA9685 channel at a pulse, bypassing the module mapping.
commands.channelStop: Cuts PWM on a raw channel, needed to stop a continuous-rotation servo.
commands.feeder: Runs one feed until module 1 sees a card, the hopper is empty, or it times out.
commands.feederValue: Drives the feeder motor at a raw pulse. It keeps spinning until you stop it.
commands.feederStop: Cuts PWM on the feeder channel.
commands.route: Feeds a card and routes it to a module's left, right or bottom output.
commands.pushTest: Runs only the push step on a module, without a card or IR checks.
commands.setConfig: Sets a module's servo pulses and push timings. Empty fields keep their current value.
commands.setFeederConfig: Sets feeder speed, timings and rollback. Empty fields keep their current value.
commands.getWifi: Reports the Wi-Fi network, IP address, signal and server link state.
commands.clearWifi: Forgets the Wi-Fi network and server link. The board stays offline until Wi-Fi is set up again.

raw.heading: Raw console
raw.description: Sends exactly this line and waits for the next reply. Invalid JSON is sent as-is, which is useful for testing firmware errors.

log.heading: Serial log
log.description: Every line sent and received on this connection, newest first, including unsolicited events like jams.

plans.featuresDescription: Which plans can use each feature. Features are defined in code, so a new one shows up here once it's built.
plans.limitsDescription: How much of each thing an organization on each plan can have. Turn on Unlimited to remove a limit.
plans.billingDisabled: Billing is turned off on this server, so every organization gets every feature with no limits. These settings take effect once billing is on.

validation.number: Enter a whole number, 0 or more

chaosSort.label: Chaos sort
chaosSort.description: Fill bins in order, ignoring rules. Turning it off only stops new presets from switching it on.

storage.label: Storage locations
storage.description: Create locations and record bins into them. Existing locations stay viewable either way.

apiAccess.label: API access
apiAccess.description: Create organization API keys and read cards and storage locations through the public API. Revoking existing keys always works.

dailyScans.label: Daily scans
dailyScans.description: Cards scanned per organization per UTC day.

connectedSorters.label: Connected sorters
connectedSorters.description: Sorters connected at once. Every plan is also capped at the server's hard maximum.

soundRules.label: Sound rules
soundRules.description: Sound rules across all games. Only checked when adding a rule.

notificationRules.label: Notification rules
notificationRules.description: Discord notification rules across all games. Only checked when adding a rule.

deletedItems.heading: Deleted items
deletedItems.description: Everything deleted in any organization, except scanned cards. Restoring puts an item back exactly as it was.

unmatchedRetry.heading: Unmatched scans
unmatchedRetry.description: The most recent unmatched scans across all organizations. Retry runs today's card matching on each scan's saved data and shows what it would match now. Nothing is saved or changed. Retrying a single scan follows live scanning: if the image match is unsure, it also runs OCR on the saved photo. Retry all only re-runs the image match, so it doesn't hold up OCR for live scans.
unmatchedRetry.searchPlaceholder: Search by organization, collection or card
unmatchedRetry.cardMissing: Matched, but the card details couldn't be loaded

statuses.no_game: No game set for this collection

toasts.retryError: Couldn't retry the scans. Try again.
toasts.ocrError: Couldn't run OCR on this scan. Try again.

detail.title: Scan details
detail.compareHint: Retry this scan to compare it with the card it would match.
detail.noDiagnostics: No diagnostics were saved for this scan.

unmatchedRetry.summary: Good photos: {{retried}} retried, {{matched}} would match, {{unmatched}} still unmatched. Bad photos: {{bad}}.

ocr.heading: Text on the card (OCR)
ocr.hint: Runs OCR on this scan's saved photo and shows each region it reads. The saved photo is lower resolution than the live camera frame, so live OCR can read slightly better.
ocr.unsupported: OCR isn't set up for this game.
ocr.noName: No card name was close enough to the text read.
ocr.usedFallback: The fallback regions were also read.
ocr.anchoredTo: Box placed on the line read as "{{text}}"

unmatchedRetry.ocrNoName: OCR read "{{text}}", no card name was close enough

platformStats.statsDescription: Which numbers to include in each post, across every organization.

scannedCards.label: Scanned cards
scannedCards.description: Every scan ever saved, matched or not. Deleting cards doesn't lower it.

scansLast24Hours.label: Scans in the last 24 hours
scansLast24Hours.description: Scans saved in the 24 hours before the post.

devices.label: Calibrated devices
devices.description: Calibrated sorters: at least one module saved with servo values other than the defaults. Deleted ones are excluded.

collections.label: Collections
collections.description: Collections across every organization, excluding deleted ones.

platformStats.scheduleDescription: Posts are sent when this command runs. Add it as a scheduled task in Coolify on the server app, with whatever cron you want.

discordChannels.botUnreachable: The Discord bot isn't reachable, so servers and channels can't be listed right now.

stats.heading: Platform stats
stats.description: Where the platform stats are posted, and which numbers each post includes. Leave the channel empty to stop posting stats.

donations.heading: Donations
donations.description: Where each Buy Me a Coffee donation is posted. Leave it empty to stop posting donations.

pricing.heading: Price updates
pricing.description: Where a summary is posted whenever the price sync pulls new prices. Leave it empty to stop posting price updates.

discordChannels.priceSyncCommand: Prices are pulled when this command runs. Add it as a scheduled task in Coolify on the server app, every few hours. It only downloads what changed upstream.
discordChannels.donationsLink: Open the Buy Me a Coffee page

linkedRole.heading: Linked account role
linkedRole.description: Members of this server who link their Mault account with /link-account get this role, and lose it when they unlink. The bot needs Manage Roles, and its own role must sit above this one.
linkedRole.saveFailed: Couldn't save the linked account role.
